title: Shrimp and Vegetable Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic North African-inspired tagine with shrimp and vegetables. Serve over couscous for a delicious and nutritious meal.
instructions: Heat oil in a large tagine or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add chopped onions and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add chopped carrots and cook until they start to soften, about 5 minutes.
Add shrimp and cook until pink, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Add cumin, coriander, and paprika, and stir to combine.
Add chopped tomatoes, salt, and pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring to a simmer, reduce heat to low, and cook, covered, until the sauce has thickened and the vegetables are tender, about 20 minutes.
Stir in chopped cilantro and serve over couscous.
Garnish with chopped crunchy and serve immediately.
